sn12.2:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you dependent origination and I will analyse it for you.
sn12.2:1.3: Listen to that and attend closely, I will speak.”
sn12.2:2.2: With ignorance as condition, volitional formations come to be;
sn12.2:2.13: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.2:3.2: The aging of the various beings in the various orders of beings, their growing old, brokenness of teeth, greyness of hair, wrinkling of skin, decline of vitality, degeneration of the faculties:
sn12.2:3.4: The passing away of the various beings from the various orders of beings, their perishing, breakup, disappearance, mortality, death, completion of time, the breakup of the aggregates, the laying down of the carcass:
sn12.2:3.6: Thus this aging and this death are together called aging-and-death.
sn12.2:4.2: The birth of the various beings into the various orders of beings, their being born, descent into the womb, production, the manifestation of the aggregates, the obtaining of the sense bases.
sn12.2:5.2: There are these three kinds of existence:
sn12.2:5.3: sense-sphere existence, form-sphere existence, formless-sphere existence.
sn12.2:6.2: There are these four kinds of clinging:
sn12.2:6.3: clinging to sensual pleasures, clinging to views, clinging to rules and vows, clinging to a doctrine of self.
sn12.2:7.2: There are these six classes of craving:
sn12.2:7.3: craving for forms, craving for sounds, craving for odours, craving for tastes, craving for tactile objects, craving for mental phenomena.
sn12.2:8.2: There are these six classes of feeling:
sn12.2:8.3: feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, feeling born of mind-contact.
sn12.2:9.2: There are these six classes of contact:
sn12.2:9.3: eye-contact, ear-contact, nose-contact, tongue-contact, body-contact, mind-contact.
sn12.2:10.1: “And what, bhikkhus, are the six sense bases?
sn12.2:10.2: The eye base, the ear base, the nose base, the tongue base, the body base, the mind base.
sn12.2:10.3: These are called the six sense bases.
sn12.2:11.4: The four great elements and the form derived from the four great elements:
sn12.2:11.6: Thus this name and this form are together called name-and-form.
sn12.2:12.2: There are these six classes of consciousness:
sn12.2:12.3: eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, mind-consciousness.
sn12.2:13.1: “And what, bhikkhus, are the volitional formations?
sn12.2:13.2: There are these three kinds of volitional formations:
sn12.2:13.3: the bodily volitional formation, the verbal volitional formation, the mental volitional formation.
sn12.2:13.4: These are called the volitional formations.
sn12.2:14.2: Not knowing suffering, not knowing the origin of suffering, not knowing the cessation of suffering, not knowing the way leading to the cessation of suffering.
sn12.2:15.1: “Thus, bhikkhus, with ignorance as condition, volitional formations come to be;
sn12.2:15.2: with volitional formations as condition, consciousness….
sn12.2:15.3: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.2:15.4: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of ignorance comes cessation of volitional formations; with the cessation of volitional formations,
sn12.2:15.6: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.”
